briefdescription.para: Mixes (merges) multiple audio files into a single file.

parameterdescription.para: A collection of filenames of audio files to mix
The filename for the resulting mixed audio file

simplesect.para: True on success, or false with error messages on failure

briefdescription.para: Creates a shared pointer to an audioFile object for a new (non-existing) audio file - Creates the appropriate subclass object, depending on the filename extension. If the format isn't recognized, returns a null pointer.

parameterdescription.para: The name of the audio file

simplesect.para: A shared pointer to an AudioFile object, which will be an instance of the appropriate subclass for the file, or a null pointer if it is not a recognized format.
